description: Read Bitwarden organization members, groups, collections, events, policies, and subscription data.

fields.label: Organization Client ID
fields.description: The client ID from the organization's Bitwarden API key. View it under Settings > Organization info: https://bitwarden.com/help/public-api/#authentication.

fields.label: Organization Client Secret
fields.description: The client secret paired with the organization API key. View or rotate it under Settings > Organization info: https://bitwarden.com/help/public-api/#authentication.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Bitwarden cloud region: us or eu.
